NSCalendarsUsageDescription: AvoCook requires calendar access because it shares the same system component as reminders, which are used for your grocery lists.
NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: AvoCook requires calendar access because it shares the same system component as reminders, which are used for your grocery lists.
NSRemindersUsageDescription: AvoCook uses your reminders to export and synchronize your grocery lists.
NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: AvoCook uses your reminders to export and synchronize your grocery lists.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose a photo to illustrate a recipe or read a photographed recipe.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Save recipe images to your photo library.
NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Connect AvoCook to your Nextcloud server on the local network.
NSCameraUsageDescription: Photograph a recipe or scan a food barcode.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Use your voice to change steps or start a timer. Voice commands are optional and audio is processed on your device.
NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Voice commands are recognized on your device. Audio is not sent to a server.
